# Eval facet map

91 of 336 always-required behaviors have no scoring case. The count is approximate. A step load counts once per playbook and name. A condition in the middle of a step leaves its names `always`.

## Legend

| kind | meaning |
|---|---|
| `activation` | The model loads a model-invocable skill when a request fits its description. |
| `hook-load` | A session-start hook names a skill to load before a new task. |
| `route` | The router says `Playbook: <slug>` or `Route: <skill>` for a task it matches. |
| `route-load` | When the router routes to a skill, the agent loads that skill. |
| `playbook-read` | The agent reads the chosen playbook file in full. |
| `step-load` | Before a playbook step, the agent loads each name in the step's parentheses. |
| `reply-load` | Before the final reply, the agent loads each name in the playbook's Reply line parentheses. |
| `trigger-load` | When a router trigger applies, the agent loads the name the trigger gives. |
| `principle-read` | The agent reads a principle's SKILL.md in full before it applies the principle. |
| `router-contract` | A rule of the router itself, pinned to an anchor phrase in the router file. Its scorer status is `invisible` even when a Skill call or Read proves the load, because the rule also sets an order or a context, such as "before match" or "the one it picks", that the scorer cannot see. |

| evidence | meaning |
|---|---|
| `skill-call` | A Skill tool call that delivers the skill body. |
| `full-read` | A Read of the whole file at `path` (plugin-relative). |
| `skill-call-or-full-read` | A Skill call by the project skill's name, or a full Read of `path` (relative to the research repository root). |
| `agent-spawn` | A subagent start whose brief carries what the rule names. |
| `assistant-text` | Text the agent writes to the user. |
| `task-list` | Task-list tool calls: one task per step, and their state changes. |
| `final-reply-section` | A section of the final reply. |
| `hook-delivery` | The session-start hook text reaches the model, then the named skill loads. |

Every read can also happen through Bash (`cat`, `sed`). The scorer records a Bash read that mentions a frozen path as `unproved`, and never counts it.

| requirement | meaning |
|---|---|
| `always` | The workflow always asks for it once its route or step is reached. |
| `conditional` | A condition in the text decides it: a step that starts with "When " or says "Skip when" or "Skip for", every trigger, every hook, and a principle no always step names. |
| `one-of` | The step picks exactly one of the names (declared in `ONE_OF` and checked against the step). |
| `transitive` | The step runs steps of another playbook, or the whole playbook (declared in `WHOLE_RUNS`), so the names in those steps load too. `via` is the step's own load facet for that playbook. `conditional` is true when the step is conditional or every step that supplies the name is conditional. |

| scope | meaning |
|---|---|
| `root` | Only the main chat satisfies it. |
| `delegate-allowed` | A load inside a subagent the step delegates to also satisfies it. The scorer records subagent loads, but no case scores them. |

| scorer | meaning |
|---|---|
| `scored` | A case field scores it. |
| `recorded` | The scorer records the load, but no case field scores it. |
| `invisible` | The scorer drops the event. |

| first-message-restatement | assistant-text | Your first message on a task: restate the question in your own words |
| go-deeper-before-match | skill-call | Run `go-deeper` on a new task, unless it already ran for this task or its skip rule applies. |
| load-names-before-step | task-list | Before a step, load each name in its parentheses that you have not loaded in this session |
| load-names-in-listed-order | task-list | that you have not loaded in this session, in the order listed. |
| one-task-per-step | task-list | create one task per step. Copy each playbook step line byte for byte, in file order. |
| pick-one-rule | skill-call | When the step text picks one of two names, load only the one it picks. |
| principle-citation | final-reply-section | In the final reply, name each principle that changed a decision and the choice it changed. |
| re-match-on-new-task | assistant-text | Match again each time this skill is invoked and whenever the user says "new task". |
| read-playbook-in-full | full-read | For a playbook, read `playbooks/<slug>.md` in full. |
| research-context-before-first-step | skill-call-or-full-read | The repository has a `research-context` project skill: load it before the first step. |
| route-declaration | assistant-text | Say `Playbook: <slug>. Reason: <one clause>.` |
| steps-section | final-reply-section | End the final reply with a "Steps" section that gives every step handle in order with its state. |
